the faculty members in this study reported that their course design practices had changed in four areas, namely the use of technology in the design and delivery of courses; the use of instructional design principles and models in the design and development of courses; the development of learning activities and materials; and the development of assessment activities and materials.

the faculty's perspectives of the changes in course design practice are: (1) the need to use a systematic and coherent approach in designing online courses, (2) the need to develop a range of competencies in the areas of learning management, course design, instructional design, and technology integration, and (3) the need to have a framework for developing competences that covers the four areas of course design practice and specifies degrees of complexity at different levels of expertise.
